title: PotatoHorror
description: A Highly Lightweight Horror Modpack Featuring Immersive Audio, Easy World Hosting, and a terrifying experience unlike anything you've encountered before...
body:
**PotatoHorror** is a lightweight horror modpack built for multiplayer gameplay and low-end PCs.\
Carefully assembled to provide an immersive experience without sacrificing performance,
the modpack is optimized for multiplayer gameplay and low-end systems.\
As the name suggests, it runs on [**potatoes**](https://www.pcgamingwiki.com/wiki/Low-end_gaming)!


<details>
<summary>Spoiler! (Don't Ruin The Surprise)</summary>

## Features:
- Dwellers (The Man From The Fog, Cave Dweller, etc)
- Stalkers (Knocker, TOWW, etc)
- Fake Players
- Fake Messages
- Fake Sounds
- Pitch Black Darkness
- Random Events (Base on Fire, Lightning, Longer Nights, [etc](https://modrinth.com/mod/server-side-horror)) 
- Camera Mod
- Added [Siren Head](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/siren-head-the-arrival)
- Added [Herobrine](https://modrinth.com/mod/from-the-fog)

</details>
